text:
maya: Quick check — planning to flip feature flag `enable_v2_models` in staging at 17:00 PT, then promote to prod at 18:00 PT today. Who's around to push? Need smoke tests, monitoring eyes, and rollback ready. Target rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. @kevin @sanjay

kevin: I can push at 17:00 PT. I'll run the smoke script and stay oncall for the 18:00 cut.

sanjay: I'll own the metrics dashboards. Which panels to watch?

maya: Watch tokens/sec, p99 latency, model error rate (model_fn_errors), and KV cache hit rate. Also watch request size and queue depth. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/flags-enable_v2

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a flag job: id=9921. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/flags/enable_v2_models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"on","rollout":10}'
```

anna: Confirming safe defaults: fallback_model=llama-2.1-quant, response_normalizer=v1 must remain enabled. Also set `safe_default:true` for unknown models in the config.

kevin: I'll keep rollback ready. Rollback command (if we need it):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/flags/enable_v2_models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"off"}'
```
I'll also have `deploy rollback 9921` handy.

sanjay: :thumbsup: I'll set alerts: +50% model error rate or p99 > 2500ms for 3m. If alert fires, we roll back immediately and notify #eng-oncall.

maya: Plan: staging flip @17:00 (10% with smoke.sh), wait 10m, bump to 50% for 10m, then 100% if stable. I'll post smoke output and ping when each stage completes. If I don't ack within 3m after a stage, ops-bot will auto-rollback based on policy.

kevin: Sounds good. I'll push at 17:00 and post logs here. If anything looks off I'll run rollback and post the reason + log snippet.

anna: Who can cancel job 9921 if needed?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: job 9921 created by maya. To cancel: `deploy cancel 9921` or open the job in Console -> Rollouts -> Job 9921.

maya: Thanks all — running final preflight now. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/flag-rollouts. I'll update status in this thread as steps complete.
